source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Regional boss and mid-boss battles: heavier and darker than the normal boss theme, a monstrous presence, menacing but exciting. Tempo 148 BPM, 4/4 time, key of F minor. Instrumentation: brass chords, chromatic low bass, timpani, driving strings, heavy drums, low choir-like pads. Form: heavy intro, riff, brass theme, riff again. Duration: 85 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
